game: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
key_point: Breath of the Wild started in 8-bit
title: Breath of the Wild started in 8-bit
caption: Breath of the Wild's first prototype was a 2D game that looked like the original NES Zelda. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #zelda #breathofthewild

instagram.caption:
At GDC 2017, Nintendo showed something nobody expected: Breath of the Wild began as a flat 2D prototype that looked like the 1986 NES Zelda.

They used it to test the game's rules: fire spreads, grass burns, wind carries things, objects react to each other.

Those rules stayed when it went 3D, and they are why the game feels so free.
